name: CKEditor 5 Custom Paste
description: Filters and customises content pasted into CKEditor 5.
project_description:
Introduction 
 The CKEditor 5 Custom Paste module is designed to enhance Drupal's content editing by providing advanced control over the pasting process in CKEditor 5. Ideal for sites requiring sophisticated content formatting, it empowers users to manage and filter HTML tags during pasting, ensuring content consistency and integrity.

 Features 
 This module allows exclusion of specific HTML tags from styling transformations when pasting into CKEditor 5. It is crucial for maintaining the structure of table layouts and other specific formats, contributing to a uniform content presentation.

 Post-Installation 
 Post-installation, administrators can navigate to the text format configuration page to enable the plugin and define tags to be excluded from styling changes during pasting. This provides a tailored experience to meet specific site requirements.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requirements include Drupal 9 or later and the CKEditor 5 module.

 Similar Projects 
 CKEditor 5 Paste Filter which also focuses on managing pasted content in CKEditor 5. However, this module has limitations in skipping complex tags, whereas the CKEditor 5 Custom Paste module offers more flexibility and control over the exclusion of specific tags during the pasting process, setting it apart in its ability to customize content handling.
